description: A report script for POS Register in ERPNext, handling data retrieval, grouping, and display of POS invoice data with filters and grouping options.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate POS register report based on filters and grouping.

methods.name: get_pos_entries
methods.description: Fetches POS invoice entries from the database based on filters and grouping.

methods.name: concat_mode_of_payments
methods.description: Concatenates mode of payment details into POS entries.

methods.name: add_subtotal_row
methods.description: Adds subtotal row for grouped data.

methods.name: validate_filters
methods.description: Validates the input filters for required fields and logical consistency.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions string based on filters.

methods.name: get_group_by_field
methods.description: Determines the database field to group by based on user selection.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report output.
